messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of quota attributions showing up under the wrong project after we rolled out role-binding sampling. Anyone seen this?

maria: Yep saw that earlier. Looks like revocations from the console are sometimes tagged with the org admin account instead of the service account.

jamal: Is this the sampling change we shipped last week? I thought we only touched sampling window and trace IDs.

alex: We did. But query in the telemetry pipeline assumes origin_project from the identity header. If the revocation path uses a proxy flow it drops the project claim. sampling made the noisy cases surface.

sara: Repro steps — from the console: click role -> revoke -> confirm. In some cases the revoke request goes through the auth-proxy which swaps headers.

maria: Quick fix suggestion: backfill origin_project from the last non-proxy auth event in the trace before sampling decisions are applied. Less risky than undoing sampling.

jamal: That would fix telemetry attribution but what about billing/quota? We can't let charges stick to org-admin. Need routing fallback at the API layer to prefer explicit key/project in the token exchange.

alex: Agreed. Plan: (1) add an API layer deterministic fallback: if token contains project claim use it, else consult authn-cache for last effective identity. (2) add a one-off job to reclassify sampled telemetry for the last 48h. (3) patch console to send an explicit X-Origin-Project header on revoke path.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy patch (canary) -> expected 30m until green.

jamal: Also add a dashboard card in Console -> Billing -> Attribution showing "attribution source" breakdown (token vs fallback vs proxy). That will help ops triage.

maria: I'll add the card mock in Figma and a short note for support. Can someone file an incident ticket for the misattributed billing spikes?

alex: Filing it now: INC-2023-rolebind-attr. Put "impact: billing attribution" and link to canary.

jamal: One more UX ask — show an audit tooltip on revoke confirming which identity will be used for billing. "You are revoking as: service-account X (project Y) — charges will apply to project Y"

alex: Nice. low-risk, improves transparency. I'll pair with UX on the tooltip text.

sara: Can we also add a short-lived metric in /metrics: auth_attribution_fallback_count so we can alert if fallback spikes during rollout?

maria: Adding to the rollout checklist.

alex: Cool. I'll monitor the canary and follow up in #incidents if anything pops. :thumbsup:
